description.value: Asom Store is a neighbourhood convenience store occupying a single-storey retail building on Oxford Street in North Vancouver, formerly operating as Oxmore Market. It serves the surrounding residential community with everyday essentials typical of a convenience shop. For touring cyclists moving through North Vancouver, it is a local stop for snacks and supplies.
